source: NACC UDS v4.0 Form C2 instructions, January 2025 (Trail Making Test, Parts A and B)
notes: Spoken lines are played in order; each line is one audio clip named by its id.
Joining a section's spoken lines with single spaces gives the source wording, minus the adaptations listed below.
An arrow replaces the previous arrow. In instruction sections, arrows clear when clicks are enabled. In the error section, the arrow stays until the next correct click.
'say' is a pronunciation hint for audio only. The displayed and stored text is always 'text'.

adaptations.sourceText: Please take the pencil and draw a line
adaptations.appText: Please click to draw a line

sourceText: Please try not to lift the pencil as you move from one number to the next.
Please try not to lift the pencil as you move from one circle to the next.
Please try not to lift the pencil as you move from one number or letter to the next.

sampleA.text: There are numbers in circles on this page.
Please click to draw a line from one number to the next, in order.
sampleA.sourceText: Please take the pencil and draw a line from one number to the next, in order.

sampleA.text: Work as quickly as you can.

partA.text: On this page there are more numbers in circles.
Please click to draw a line from one circle to the next, in order.
partA.sourceText: Please take the pencil and draw a line from one circle to the next, in order.

partA.text: Work as quickly as you can.

sampleB.text: There are numbers and letters in circles on this page.
Please click to draw a line, alternating in order between the numbers and letters.
sampleB.sourceText: Please take the pencil and draw a line, alternating in order between the numbers and letters.

sampleB.text: then go to the first letter, A,
then go to the next number, 2,
and then the next letter, B,
Work as quickly as you can.

partB.text: On this page, there are more numbers and letters in circles.
Please click to draw a line from one circle to the next, alternating in order between the numbers and letters.
partB.sourceText: Please take the pencil and draw a line from one circle to the next, alternating in order between the numbers and letters.

partB.text: Work as quickly as you can.
